description: Sleeper routes from the atlas, sorted by renown — all of them by default, or only those starting or ending in a given city — with the per-city night-train guide URL when one exists. Use for overnight and sleeper questions; city_pair for concrete A-to-B times; search_routes for other route categories.

city.description: Optional city filter matched against route endpoints (accent-insensitive), e.g. "Vienna".
